title: A Candidate Exact Three-Item Independent-Cap Oracle
oneLine: A producer-side candidate exact oracle gives a rational three-item max-frequency relaxation-gap lower bound of 1.1487291464748206... and a verifier-checked route to instance-specific logistics stress tests.
abstract: This anonymous unrefereed successor candidate constructs an exact three-item independent-cap oracle for continuous-time common-origin fixed-interval joint replenishment. A finite primitive-triple enumeration and strict global tail candidate theorem support an exact rational bundled-instance ratio of 1.1487291464748205845..., 3.3132 percent above the producer-side unrefereed two-item upper endpoint. A monotonicity lemma propagates the candidate lower bound to every fixed item count of at least three. An exact five-policy family explains the witness, while sixteen exact vertex certificates prove two conservative inner boxes under simultaneous relative holding-cost perturbation only. The bundled five-policy sets are synthetic regression fixtures; every fitted logistics instance must regenerate and verifier-check its own candidate set across primitive and boundary regimes. The 14.8729 percent lower-bound optimism is not a savings claim. Independent rerun, reimplementation, formal verification, external specialist review, external editorial peer review, operational validation, and field impact are not assessed.
keyResults: The lower bound is 3.3132 percent above the producer-side unrefereed two-item upper endpoint and propagates to every fixed item count n at least 3, subject to the candidate proof boundary.
The finite closure enumerates 49,981 primitive triples at minimal cutoff S=21 and proves a strict omitted-triple tail margin.
Sixteen exact vertex certificates prove two conservative simultaneous holding-cost inner boxes; the frozen five-policy sets are synthetic regression fixtures only.
The exact oracle is proposed as a logistics stress test and regression benchmark; no field saving or operational impact is claimed.

semanticBridge.description: Common and item-specific model coefficients map to incremental replenishment-event, handling, and deterministic holding costs only after domain validation. The exact oracle maps to a triplet benchmark, not directly to executed orders.
remainingRisks: Frequency caps may be invalid proxies for pointwise transport or dock capacity.
Stochastic demand, lead times, service, order rounding, minimum quantities, and nonlinear tariffs are outside the certificate.
No representative company dataset or field comparison has been evaluated.

humanJudgmentGates: Confirm that the three items share an incremental common event and every coefficient has defensible operational semantics.
Keep exact synthetic lower-bound optimism separate from savings or field performance.
Require simulation and shadow evaluation before any order execution.
Require preregistered service stop rules and a defensible comparator before causal or net-value language.
